Fall 2 Deadpoint Plot : After losing her fearless sister Hunter, a deeply damaged Jax sets out on a dangerous climb with Hunter’s old friend to honor her memory. As they tightrope walk the perilous planks of Mount Kwan, a terrifying rockslide leaves them stranded 5,000 feet above ground. In the face of vertigo-inducing sequences, dark truths, and cruel twists, Jax must confront her deepest fears head-on to fight for survival and closure.

Fall 2 Deadpoint is an upcoming American survival thriller film directed by Peter and Michael Spierig from a screenplay by Scott Mann and Jonathan Frank. It serves as a sequel to Fall (2022).

Fall 2 Deadpoint - only in theaters September 2. Starring Harriet Slater, Arsema Thomas, Tom Brittney, Virginia Gardner, and Grace Caroline Currey. Directed by The Spierig Brothers.
